//: LibreLane configuration for the standard Tiny Tapeout flow (gds.yaml):
tt-support-tools adds the source list, die area and floorplan template
from info.yaml (src/user_config.json) and merges this file over them.
The TT07 chip was hardened locally instead (../build.py, ../config.json)
to place the RAM32 DFFRAM macro; see README.md.

PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - increase if Global Placement fails with GPL-0302. This standard flow (the RAM synthesized) does not route on the 4x4 tile: its global route needs 128% of the met1-met4 resources at 85 and 144% at 70; the chip is built with the RAM32 macro (harden/, gds_custom.yaml), see RESPIN.md.
CLOCK_PERIOD in ns: 30 ns == 33 MHz, the TT07 constraint (its impl.sdc; the chip runs at 66 MHz).

PL_MAX_DISPLACEMENT_Y - the legalizer may move a cell this far (um; 100 by default): the short rows beside the RAM32 macro (146 um tall) run ~90% full and after the hold buffers a few cells there have to leave the pocket.

RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR, RUN_POST_GRT_RESIZER_TIMING - off: tried for the post-route slews (the placement-stage estimate is far below extraction here), they add ~20 buffers and 60 upsizes, then re-legalize with ~10K mirrored instances after the global route and tripled the detailed router's violations in the dense bins (RESPIN.md, the third build).
Hold slack margin - increase in case of hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - disabling the linter is not recommended!
The core's multi-cycle paths (the PC, instruction cache, debugger to the registers decode reaches): lisa.sdc = LibreLane's base.sdc plus those

EXTRA_EXCLUDED_CELLS - LibreLane keeps the resizer off only the PDK's drc_exclude.cells, and OpenROAD starts every fanout, wire and port buffer from the weakest buffer left, which on sky130 is the delay cell clkdlybuf4s25_1 (1548 of 1589 fanout buffers in the first routed build: 1.4-2.5 ns slews, -9.4 ns setup at the slow corner after routing). TT07's OpenLane 2 build used buf_2 / clkbuf_4 / buf_4. The delay cells stay out of the data repairs; dlygate4sd3_1 stays in for the hold repair (TT07's hold buffer).

SYNTH_EXCLUDED_CELL_FILE - the PDK's no_synth.cells keeps synthesis off nearly every _1 logic cell and flop (199 entries), so the design maps to _2 cells and comes out ~25% larger than TT07's build, which used them (16.4K of its 20K logic cells are _1; how its OpenLane 2.0.4 run got past the same list is not known). Upstream open_pdks removed the combinational _1 cells from the list on 2026-05-28 (now libs.tech/librelane/.../synth_excluded.cells, 23 globs), but every LibreLane 3.0.x release so far, the TT action's 3.0.5 included, pins open_pdks 8afc834 of 2025-07 with the 199-entry list. src/no_synth.cells is the PDK list without the _1 combinational cells and plain flops; the clock, delay, scan and latch cells stay excluded.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
